provenance: Stock QIDI Plus 5 (firmware 01.01.01.07) as the machine reports itself: /printer/objects/list, /printer/info, and the klipper-macros-qd/ config on the device.
notes: HelixScreen's detector hostname is Moonraker's machine_name ('QIDI'); the OS hostname is 'qidi-plus5'. Neither names the model, so the bed size is what separates the Plus 5 from the Q2 (~275) and Max 4 (~390) once the QIDI family is identified.

build_volume is the stepper travel Klipper resolves from configfile (X[-7,326] = 333, Y[-5,340] = 345), which is what PrinterDiscovery::parse_build_volume() stores and build_volume_range heuristics are scored against. It is ~8mm larger than the 325x325 print area.
The main MCU is an STM32F407; the toolhead ('mcu THR') is an STM32F103xe.
